MAC address must be 6 octets (e.g. 02:00:00:00:00:01).
TAP name must be 16 chars or fewer with no spaces.

WebUI port must be between 1 and 65535.
WebUI listen IP must be a valid IPv4 address.
WebUI listen IPv6 must be a valid IPv6 address.
PCAP sample interval must be 1 or greater.
PCAP max rate must be 0 or greater.
WAN interface must be 16 chars or fewer; only letters, digits, - _ . are allowed.
Obfuscation mode must be fixed, block, random, dynamic or auto.
Fixed size must be greater than 0 when mode is fixed.
Block size must be greater than 0 when mode is block.
Jitter range must be 0 or greater.
Min size must be less than or equal to max size.
Max fragment size must be 0 (auto) or 256–1400.
Obfuscation algorithm must be auto, none, aes-gcm or chacha20.
Auto-detect interval must be greater than 0 (seconds).
Auto-detect threshold must be greater than 0 (bytes).
ACL default action must be accept/allow or drop/deny.
Check ACL rule fields: action, direction, protocol, IP CIDR, peer ID, and port.
Each entry must be a valid peer ID or *.
Each subnet must be a valid network CIDR (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).
